problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet of seven specialized transport vehicles to deliver seven distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is listed below:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 6.583 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 18.666 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 6.868 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 18.399 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 12.047 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 11.824 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 10.097 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each vehicle is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.949 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.879 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.217 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.804 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.68 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.62 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 0.647 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.065 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.883 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.243 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.502 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.211 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.929 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.576 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.003 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.973 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.656 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.055 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.611 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.71 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.376 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.279 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.873 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.944 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.14 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.358 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.74 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.132 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.412 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.903 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.479 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.266 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.766 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.649 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.578 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.043 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.42 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.941 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.546 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.904 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.617 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.643 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Eta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.93 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.798 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.428 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.138 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.503 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.53 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.862 (ton-hours)

* Vehicle 1's total available handling time cannot surpass 228.559 hours
* Vehicle 2's total available handling time cannot surpass 267.077 hours
* Vehicle 3's total available handling time cannot surpass 213.711 hours
* Vehicle 4's total available handling time cannot surpass 185.556 hours
* Vehicle 5's total available handling time cannot surpass 208.589 hours
* Vehicle 6's total available handling time cannot surpass 182.44 hours
* Vehicle 7's total available handling time cannot surpass 218.212 hours

Under the condition that for each vehicle—Vehicle 1, Vehicle 2, Vehicle 3, Vehicle 4, Vehicle 5, Vehicle 6, Vehicle 7—the cumulative handling duration must remain within its allotted time, determine the optimal tonnage for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
